I'm a supply chain professional completing a **Master of Science in Supply
Chain Management (Data Analytics concentration) at Boston University**.
My experience spans GMP logistics, precision manufacturing for subsea fiber
optic systems, preconstruction cost estimation, and program operations. I
combine that hands-on operational background with growing skills in data
analytics and cloud computing.

Currently, I'm a **Logistics Specialist at Lonza** in Portsmouth, NH,
managing GMP logistics, inventory movements, and shipping with SAP,
Syncade, and TrackWise.

## What I Bring
- **Excel (Advanced):** quantitative analysis, financial modeling, demand forecasting, capacity planning, and operational dashboards
- **Lean & Quality:** Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, DMAIC, control charts, statistical process control
- **Data Analytics (Growing):** Python, Pandas, PySpark, R/RStudio for data cleaning, regression, clustering, and time series forecasting
- **Cloud & Tools:** AWS EC2, Git/GitHub, VS Code, Jupyter Notebooks, Quarto
- **Operations Systems:** SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Bluebeam Revu

## Career Goals
I'm pursuing roles in **supply chain analytics, logistics, and operations**
where I can use data to improve processes, forecast demand, and support
better business decisions.
